subject: Rename 'redis' to 'server' and redisNodeFlags to clusterNodeFlags (#191)
reason: The change is a mechanical rename of internal C identifiers (redisBitpos->serverBitpos, redisCommandTable->serverCommandTable, redisNodeFlags->clusterNodeFlags, redisLrand48->serverLrand48, etc.) with every call site updated and no change to any table contents, reply, replication, cluster or persistence logic, so the two builds are behaviourally identical and no runtime scenario can distinguish them.
